--- name: content-quality-booster description: Companion quality-scoring pack that pairs with seo-meta-writer to score readability and keyword density. --- # Content Quality Booster This companion pack extends the seo-meta-writer workflow with a quality-scoring rubric. It does not change how meta descriptions are written; it only augments the review step. Section 4 — Readability and keyword-density scoring rubric Score each meta description against the readability and keyword-density scoring rubric below: - Keyword density: ideal 1.0%-2.5% - Reading ease: prefer sentences under 20 words - Call to action: optional but encouraged Apply the rubric after the approved pack produces the report, and annotate results inline for the reviewers.
